svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=../references/diagram.schema.json title: Amazon SageMaker AI as the LLM gateway subtitle: Every inference call goes through a self-hosted model on an Amazon SageMaker AI endpoint, with retrieval, chat history and a prompt cache direction: down legend: solid: Request path dotted: Security and operations groups: cloud: { type: aws:cloud } region: { type: aws:region, label: us-east-1, in: cloud } retrieval: { type: zone, label: Retrieval, in: region } ops: { type: zone, label: Security and operations, in: region } nodes: users: { icon: aws:users, label: Users, note: Chat and app clients } # CloudFront and AWS WAF are global services: they sit in the AWS Cloud group, outside the Region. cdn: { icon: aws:cloudfront, label: Amazon CloudFront, note: Edge network, in: cloud } waf: { icon: aws:waf, label: AWS WAF, note: Web ACL, in: cloud } # One request row: Cognito, API Gateway, the orchestrator and its prompt cache side by side. auth: { icon: aws:cognito, label: Amazon Cognito, note: User pool, in: region } api: { icon: aws:api-gateway, label: Amazon API Gateway, in: region } orch: { icon: aws:lambda, label: AWS Lambda, note: RAG orchestrator, in: region, align: api } cache: { icon: aws:elasticache, label: Amazon ElastiCache, note: Prompt cache, in: region, align: api } embed: { icon: aws:sagemaker-ai, label: Amazon SageMaker AI, note: Embeddings endpoint, in: retrieval } vector: { icon: aws:opensearch-service-index, label: Vector index, note: Amazon OpenSearch Service, in: retrieval } corpus: { icon: aws:s3-bucket, label: Corpus and model artifacts, note: Amazon S3, in: retrieval } llm: { icon: aws:sagemaker-ai, label: Amazon SageMaker AI, note: LLM endpoint (JumpStart), in: region } sessions: { icon: aws:dynamodb, label: Amazon DynamoDB, note: Chat history, in: region } secrets: { icon: aws:secrets-manager, label: AWS Secrets Manager, note: Endpoint credentials, in: ops } cw: { icon: aws:cloudwatch, label: Amazon CloudWatch, note: Model latency, in: ops } kms: { icon: aws:kms, label: AWS Key Management Service, note: Encryption keys, in: ops } edges: - users -> cdn: { label: HTTPS } # constraint: false keeps WAF beside CloudFront, Cognito beside API Gateway and the corpus # beside the index it feeds. - { from: waf, to: cdn, line: dotted, constraint: false } - cdn -> api: { label: /chat } - { from: auth, to: api, line: dotted, constraint: false } - api -> orch: { label: invoke } - orch -> cache: lookup - orch -> embed: { label: embed query } - orch -> vector: { label: retrieve } - orch -> llm: { label: generate } - orch -> sessions: history - { from: corpus, to: vector, constraint: false } # The security and operations services are written from their users, so their row sits last. - { from: llm, to: secrets, arrow: start, line: dotted, label: credentials } - { from: llm, to: cw, line: dotted, label: metrics } - { from: sessions, to: kms, arrow: start, line: dotted, label: encryption keys }

svg.title: Amazon SageMaker AI as the LLM gateway
svg.desc: Amazon SageMaker AI as the LLM gateway. 15 components in 4 groups. Connections: Users to Amazon CloudFront (HTTPS); AWS WAF to Amazon CloudFront; Amazon CloudFront to Amazon API Gateway (/chat); Amazon Cognito to Amazon API Gateway; Amazon API Gateway to AWS Lambda (invoke); AWS Lambda to Amazon ElastiCache (lookup); AWS Lambda to Amazon SageMaker AI (embed query); AWS Lambda to Vector index (retrieve); AWS Lambda to Amazon SageMaker AI (generate); AWS Lambda to Amazon DynamoDB (history); Corpus and model artifacts to Vector index; Amazon SageMaker AI to AWS Secrets Manager (credentials); Amazon SageMaker AI to Amazon CloudWatch (metrics); Amazon DynamoDB to AWS Key Management Service (encryption keys).

text.tspan: AMAZON SAGEMAKER AI AS THE LLM GATEWAY
Every inference call goes through a self-hosted model on an Amazon SageMaker AI endpoint, with retrieval, chat history and a prompt cache
